environment.description: Ktor microservice deployed on EKS cluster in us-east-1. Service runs in a pod with default service account. AWS IMDS v1 is enabled on the node (IMDSv2 not enforced). The service is exposed via a Kubernetes ClusterIP service and accessed through an nginx ingress controller with no client certificate requirements. Network policies are not enforced (Calico not installed). The pod can reach any IP within the VPC including the metadata service at 169.254.169.254.

config.ingress: nginx-ingress with TLS termination, no client cert
